text:
Victor Nguyen: hey all, first week here — quick question about feature flags and rollout approvals. who owns the flag config (LaunchDarkly) vs who signs off on a gradual rollout to prod?
Anya Cole: welcome Victor! short: Feature flag config (environments/keys) is owned by the service team (see infra/OWNERS.md). Platform Ops owns infra wiring (k8s sidecars, proxies) and the global LD account billing/permissions.
Victor Nguyen: got it. so if i need a new flag `enable_new_router` for the embed service, i PR the service repo and update `infra/flags.yaml`?
Anya Cole: yep. PR the flag definition + a note in the release doc. For rollout policy (percent, intervals) the service owners propose it and the Release Manager approves for coordinated launches.
Platform Ops: Release Manager approval flow: 1) create a Release Issue with proposed flag, rollout %s, and metrics to watch; 2) ping #release-war-room and tag `@release-manager`; 3) if infra changes required (sidecar, configmap) tag `@platform` in the issue.
Victor Nguyen: who is the Release Manager by default? onboarding doc mentions a person for each release but not the default for small flags.
Anya Cole: default is the service's Release Lead listed in the OWNERS.md under `release-lead`. If none set, default to the team's Eng Manager. For cross-service flags, Release Manager is Product + Release Lead.
Victor Nguyen: timeline question: if i want to ramp from 0% -> 50% over 24 hours, is that considered "standard" and can oncall approve?
Platform Ops: Standard ramp (0->50% in 24h) is fine with Release Lead approval. Oncall can approve emergency quick ramps for critical fixes but you must document the rollback plan and alert windows.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: For any experiment that touches PII or customer data, include Security and Privacy in the approval chain.
Victor Nguyen: thanks — last nit: who updates the global LD groups so a new hire can toggle flags? i couldn't find LD access in the handbook.
Anya Cole: LD group membership is managed via `launchdarkly-admins@` and provisioned by Platform + People Ops. Open a ticket with the LD team, include manager approval and the service alias, and we'll sync the group.
release-bot: Release Issue REL-7812 created by Victor Nguyen: "enable_new_router flag for embed-service"  assignee: release-manager  status: review
Victor Nguyen: perfect, thanks everyone! saving this thread for other new hires. :sparkles:
Anya Cole: welcome aboard — feel free to DM if you want a quick run-through of the rollout playbook.
